summary: This video features an in-depth breakdown of the premium legendary hero Elecebre alongside a 300-pull summoning session on her dedicated banner. Elecebre is highlighted as a top-tier crowd control support featuring AoE Charm, ultimate meter drain, team defensive buffs, and a passive that matches her Resistance to her Accuracy. Her exclusive artifact, Beguiling Circlet, is analyzed as best-in-slot for granting extensive damage mitigation via Aegis stacks. Brief commentary is also provided for other legendary supports pulled during the session, including Talwer, Oggok, Ripekas, Donella, and Solmo.

heroes.name: Elecebre
heroes.note: Provides AoE Charm to turn enemies against each other, 50% ultimate gauge reduction, team healing/defense buffs, start-of-battle Blind, and automatically scales Resistance to match Accuracy.

heroes.name: Talwer
heroes.note: Brings extensive utility including Accuracy Penalty, Attack Penalty, Heal Reduction, Taunt, and Stuns.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Summons a totem granting allies temporary immortality (immunity to death) alongside solid healing and Attack Penalty II.

heroes.name: Ripekas
heroes.note: Deals AoE Knock-Up and Stun while decreasing ultimate energy and inflicting random debuffs.

heroes.name: Donella
heroes.note: Inflicts Stun, Accuracy Penalty, Attack Penalty, and passive Heal Prohibition.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Grants team shields, Debuff Immunity, Defense Up, and boosts ally Enlightenment and Max HP through Tempered stacks.

tips: Building Accuracy on Elecebre simultaneously builds her Resistance thanks to her Blinding Beauty passive equalizer.
Prioritize getting Elecebre's exclusive artifact, Beguiling Circlet, because it applies Aegis (70% damage reduction) to low-health allies when she lands CC.
title: GOD-TIER RATES! Huge Pulls for Elecebre + DARK LADY STATUE WINNER! ⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
